resources.string: One file with all lists, entries, notes and pictures. Keep it somewhere safe, e.g. in your cloud.
Load an .ordobackup file, e.g. on a new phone.
The backup could not be saved. Please try another location.
This backup comes from a newer version of Ordo. Lists, entries, pictures and notes come across completely; things newer versions added may be missing. Update Ordo to be sure.
Your current lists are replaced by the backup.
Adds what is missing; for the same entry the newer version wins. Your order stays as it is.
Before restoring, Ordo saves your current state, so you can go back.
This file is not an Ordo backup.
This backup is damaged and was not restored. Your lists are unchanged.
This backup needs a newer version of Ordo. Please update the app first.
This backup is too large to restore.
The backup could not be read.
Deleted lists and entries stay here for 30 days.
Ordo follows your phone’s language. You can choose a different one for Ordo only.
